features.quote: Apply up to 3 nudges per episode; after the 3rd finish(blocked) (or 3 consecutive tool-free turns), the episode ends.
features.justification_quote: without forced continuation, stable models exit early and you get no trajectory; with unlimited forcing, you're measuring the harness, not the model

features.quote: Termination: tests pass (C/D), 3rd nudge exhausted, 40 turns, or context overflow
